title: Proper direct image preserves bounded constructible complexes (ring of integers)
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ in which $\ell$ is invertible. Let $E\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $\Lambda=\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ the condensed ring of its integers [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For a scheme $T$ write $\Lambda_T$ for the pulled-back coefficient ring [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and $D(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})$ for the derived category of module objects on the pro-étale site of $T$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Let $Y$ be a Noetherian $k$-scheme (quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]) and $p\colon Z\to Y$ a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism]. If $K\in D(\Mod_{\Lambda_Z})$ is bounded constructible [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], then $Rp_*K\in D(\Mod_{\Lambda_Y})$ is bounded constructible.

proof.text: The specified coefficient has IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient via its continuous, integral or algebraicClosure constructor, with exactly the given multiplication. Unpack bounded constructibility as boundedness of K and constructibility of each H^q(K). The latter puts every H^q(K) in constructibleCoproductClosure by le_weakSerreCoproductClosure; this replete property contains zero.

Apply properLowerStar_uniformBound_ellAdic to the given prime, coefficient, field, structure map, Noetherian target and proper morphism. Obtain one integer d bounding the images of all degree-zero objects in constructibleCoproductClosure. If K is at most b, the triangulated and shift-compatible total right derived functor and isLE_obj_of_isLE_of_homologyProperty give Rp_* K at most b+d. Its hypotheses are boundedness of K and the cohomology containment from the preceding step.

If K is at least a, Functor.isGE_rightDerivedFunctor_obj, already proved in the public ConstructibleDirectImage dependency, gives Rp_* K at least a. This is the bounded-below comparison with R^+; the module heart is Grothendieck abelian, hence has enough injectives and K-injective resolutions, and the underived pushforward is additive. Thus Rp_* K is bounded with lower bound a and upper bound b+d. The bounded predicate does not require the displayed endpoints to be ordered, so it also covers the zero image and disjoint bounds.

Apply properLowerStar_constructible_cohomology_ellAdic with the same coefficient and geometric hypotheses to K and its original bounded-constructibility proof. Every cohomology object of Rp_* K is constructible. Pair this with the preceding boundedness to obtain boundedConstructible. No characteristic-positivity or finite-type assumption on aY is introduced.

It adds no new nodes and cites no SGA. (1) The statement change is right: dropping [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting] matches the bound upstream Lean (ProperLowerStarEllAdic.lean:93-101: ringChar k ≠ ℓ, any aY, IsNoetherian Y, IsProper p). That definition would force char p>0 and finite type; for example k=Q with Y=Z=Spec Q meets the Lean hypotheses but not the definition. The change strengthens the statement, and the only citer works in the standing setting. (2) Bhatt–Scholze Thm 6.7.1 and Lemma 6.7.2 have a 'proper' alternative with no excellence assumption, and Remark 6.8.15 covers O_E. The cited Noetherian nodes lem-sfb-noetherian-proper-heart-uniform-bound and lem-sfb-noetherian-proper-constructible-cohomology carry this under exactly the item's hypotheses, including the induced-integer constructor. (3) Steps checked: step 1 unpacks the definition. Step 2 gets a lower bound c from the D+ comparison. Step 3 gives a uniform d on P_Z, which contains each H^i(K). Step 4 applies the devissage, using a triangulated, shift-compatible Rp_* and the fact that P_Z is replete with 0 in it, so the image is at most b+d. Step 5 gives constructible H^q. Step 6 uses the interval [c,max(c,b+d)]. Edge cases checked: K=0, empty Z, p=id over Q, P^1 with K=Λ, and c>b+d. (4) No duplicate: det-thm-sfb-proper-base-change-integral covers only the standing setting. No cycle after the fix. The 5 declared tool_uses are accepted, plus 5 generic ones that I added. FIX (C1/B3, 2 faults): step 2 used the EnoughInjectives/K-injective hypotheses of src-right-derived-functor-plus-compatibility and the existence of R^+ without citing any node. I now cite lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-tensor-closed, lem-sfb-modobj-grothendieck, lem-sp-grothendieck-enough-injectives, lem-sfb-grothendieck-k-injective and lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-plus-injective, as the sibling qbar item does. Removing dc-setting also left 'pulled-back coefficient ring' without a definition, so I added [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] to the statement and stmt_deps. proof_deps is recomputed as the union of all uses.
